groups.reason: Registration data for a receptionist does not clearly include a true/false field the attendant would edit themselves.
Registration data usually includes a date of birth and possibly a hire date, which are date-only fields.
A personal registration record has no start/end date range.
Nothing in the registration data needs scheduling or a date with time; plain dates are covered by groupEnterDate.
There are no bookings or timestamped ranges in a personal registration record.
The attendant's registration data has no monetary values; fees belong to members, not to this record.
No numeric quantities or measurements are expected in the attendant's registration data.
There is no numeric range in a personal registration record.
Core of the registration data: name, email, phone and tax ID (CPF) with masked input, and possibly a password.
No single time-of-day field is needed; the work shift is a start/end range.
The receptionist's work shift (start and end time) is part of the attendant's registration data.
A short registration form does not need collapsible sections.
The registration data may include the attendant's home address, entered by address search with autocomplete.
This is a single detail view with no sections to switch between.
Viewing or editing your own registration is not a multi-step process.
Needed to tell the user whether saving changes to their registration data succeeded or failed.
There is no audio or video content in a registration detail.
Nothing in the registration data needs a rating or score.
Capturing data with the camera is not part of editing your own registration.
A single person's record needs no text search.
Lets the attendant upload or change their profile photo in the registration data.
No field in the registration data clearly needs multiple choices.
Single-choice fields such as gender, state (UF) or gym branch/unit in the registration data.
No long-running operation needs progress feedback in this detail; buttons already have a loading state.
Buttons for actions on the registration detail: edit, save and cancel.
The detail is a single form; showing items as independent cards is not needed.
There is no data to chart in personal registration data.
This shows one record, not a collection of records.
There is no parent-child data structure in a registration record.
The registration detail has no indicators or KPIs.
There is no tabular data in a single person's registration.
